2124282426209775663.en_summary: @KobeissiLetter notes Anthropic's cash and equivalents at record $237B after IPO raised $81B plus $26B private placement. Compares to Alphabet $GOOGL, Amazon $AMZN, SpaceX $SPCX, Apple $AAPL each holding less than 25% of this, so Anthropic larger than those 4 combined. Also 8x $NVDA cash, 12x $MSFT, 22x $META. Berkshire at $377B. Anthropic has huge cash to deploy.
2124282426209775663.zh_summary: @KobeissiLetter 指出 Anthropic 現金及等價物達創紀錄 2370 億美元，IPO 募集 810 億美元另加 260 億美元私募。對比 Alphabet $GOOGL、Amazon $AMZN、SpaceX $SPCX、Apple $AAPL 各自持有少於該金額的 25%，因此 Anthropic 大於這 4 家公司總和。亦是 $NVDA 現金的 8 倍、$MSFT 的 12 倍、$META 的 22 倍。Berkshire 為 3770 億美元。Anthropic 有大量現金可部署。

2124277210156863903.en_summary: @moninvestor says when stock keeps going down it's easy to look for something wrong with the company, did so with $IREN, but other AI stocks followed also down. Would have been down whichever owned. At these prices, IREN still the stock most like to own. Thinks some manipulation, big buyers happy to let people sell so they can buy cheaper.
2124277210156863903.zh_summary: @moninvestor 表示當股票持續下跌時容易開始找公司問題，自己對 $IREN 也這樣做過，但其他跟隨的 AI 股票也下跌。無論持有哪一隻本月都會下跌。在這些價格，IREN 仍是最想持有的股票。認為有些操縱，大買家樂於讓人賣出以便更便宜買入。

ticker_notes.IREN: 現價仍是最想持有，認為有操縱讓大戶低吸
